name: mcp-kanban
description: A local task board per project: columns, due dates, estimates, priorities and a link into your time tracker. All data stays on your machine.

license_key.title: License key
license_key.description: Optional Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Leave blank to use the free tier.

tools.name: task_add
tools.description: Add a task to a project board (todo list / kanban card). Optional column, due date, estimate, priority, tags and notes.

tools.name: task_list
tools.description: List tasks as a table, filtered by project, column, tag, due date or overdue.

tools.name: task_move
tools.description: Move a task to another column on its board.

tools.name: task_update
tools.description: Change any field of a task: title, notes, due date, estimate, priority, tags or project.

tools.name: task_done
tools.description: Mark a task done: it moves to the done column and is stamped with the time.

tools.name: task_search
tools.description: Find tasks whose title, notes, tags or id match a query.

tools.name: board
tools.description: Column-by-column summary of a project board: task counts and estimate totals.

tools.name: task_start_timer
tools.description: Return the exact arguments to pass to the time-tracker server's timer_start for this task, and record the link on the task.

tools.name: task_log_time
tools.description: Add real minutes worked to a task, so estimate and actual can be compared.

tools.name: project_list
tools.description: All project boards with open task counts, remaining estimate and overdue counts.

tools.name: overdue
tools.description: Every task past its due date, across all boards.

tools.name: weekly_review
tools.description: Done versus planned for a week, with estimate against actual minutes per project.

tools.name: columns_set
tools.description: Replace the columns of one board (Pro). Tasks sitting in a removed column move to the first column.

tools.name: license_status
tools.description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

tools.name: license_activate
tools.description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.
